name: quavence-vault-extension
description: Official Non-Custodial Browser Extension for Quavence (QVNC)

scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && node scripts/build_standalone_background.mjs && node -e "fs.copyFileSync('manifest.json', 'dist/manifest.json')"
scripts.test: tsx src/shared/crypto/__tests__/crypto.test.ts && tsx src/shared/crypto/__tests__/txBuilder.test.ts && tsx scripts/test_security_patch.ts && tsx scripts/test_audit2_fix.ts && tsx scripts/test_audit4_carrier_fail_loudly.ts
